title: Tashkent Rising Revisited
author: Tamsin Underhill
blurb: Elodie Thornbury, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
